Hi Rob,

No need to sit tight. Going on Discord is the right move and the fastest way to get the KD Box flashed. Post a photo of the screen at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf and mention @nullhashrate, who is JD. He and the community can take you through the reflash step by step.

If JD answers by email instead, it will come in this same thread. Our emails sometimes end up in spam, so it's worth checking there and adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts.

A room just for mining is a good way to build a collection. Your 40T is paid in full and still ships December 7, 2026.

Sarah

Hi Rob,

You're right to be fed up. You've been reporting this KBOX since November 4. It was delivered October 29, and it still hasn't been sorted. I'm sorry.

Please don't send it back on your own yet. Without our return reference and prepaid label, a box can arrive at the warehouse with nothing to match it to your order, and that only slows things down. The return is already set up on our side to go to our warehouse with a prepaid label. The only thing missing is the warranty approval.

That approval is the one step I can't do myself. The team picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET. Once it's approved, you'll get the label and the reference by email in this thread. All you'll need to do is pack the unit, write the reference on the outside of the box and drop it off.

So for now, yes, you don't need to do anything. Your Magic M. 40T order is separate and isn't affected.

Sarah

The only thing it's waiting on is a person to approve the warranty return. I can't give that approval myself, and I won't pretend I can.

I've asked for a person to take this over, not another reply from me. I've marked it as urgent and included your phone number. The team is offline now and picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET. Their answer comes to this email.

Please hold on to the unit until the label arrives, so it's matched to your order when it reaches us.

Sarah
